create_grid_search: create a GridSearch object via SearchMethodFactory to exhaustively tune time series model hyperparameters
create_random_search: create a RandomSearch object via SearchMethodFactory to randomly sample hyperparameters for a time series model
create_bayesian_opt_search: create a BayesianOptSearch object via SearchMethodFactory to use Bayesian optimization for time series hyperparameter tuning
create_nevergrad_search: create a NevergradOptSearch object via SearchMethodFactory to use Nevergrad for time series hyperparameter optimization
compute_search_cardinality: compute the cardinality of a parameter search space to determine if it is finite or infinite
